title: Part 3 - Topic 1: Ways to Protect the Environment
content:
Topic: Effective ways to protect the environment
Suggestions:
- Stopping the use of single-use plastic bags
- Switching to alternative and renewable energy sources
- Using public transportation instead of private vehicles
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. In what ways do people commonly negatively affect the environment?
2. Do you think the environment will get better in the future? Why or why not?
3. Should large corporations join hands to protect the environment? Why?

hint.coreTopic: effective ways to protect the environment

followUps.answer: There are some common ways people harm the environment, such as throwing away plastic waste, wasting water, and driving too many private vehicles.
followUps.example: For example, many shoppers still ask for three or four plastic bags at local markets and throw them away after just ten minutes.
followUps.q: In what ways do people commonly negatively affect the environment?
followUps.reason: Daily bad habits and improper disposal of rubbish and electronic waste cause serious air and water pollution.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think the environment can get better in the future if both individuals and governments take strong action.
followUps.example: For instance, many young people now carry reusable water bottles and ride electric buses to school or work.
followUps.q: Do you think the environment will get better in the future? Why or why not?
followUps.reason: More people now raise their awareness of environmental protection and choose green habits, while clean technology is becoming cheaper.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think large corporations should join hands with the government to protect the environment, and authorities must introduce stricter rules.
followUps.example: For example, electronics companies can run e-waste recycling programs and design products that are easier to repair and reuse.
followUps.q: Should large corporations join hands to protect the environment? Why?
followUps.reason: Factories produce huge amounts of waste and carbon emissions, so companies must take responsibility, recycle materials, and face heavy fines if they pollute.

mindmapPoints.cue: Stopping the use of single-use plastic bags
mindmapPoints.expand: because reducing plastic use and recycling can help combat pollution and protect natural habitats.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for keeping nature and ecosystems healthy.
mindmapPoints.sentence: People can stop using single-use plastic bags when shopping every day.

mindmapPoints.cue: Switching to alternative and renewable energy sources
mindmapPoints.expand: For example, installing solar panels on rooftops reduces dependence on fossil fuels, even though initial setup costs can be high.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to lowering air pollution and saving energy.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Society can switch to alternative energy sources like solar and wind power.

mindmapPoints.cue: Using public transportation instead of private vehicles
mindmapPoints.expand: This is because public transport reduces traffic congestion and carbon emissions in crowded cities.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on air quality and people's physical health.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Citizens can use public transport instead of driving private cars and motorbikes.

Energy sources like solar and wind power reduce dependence on fossil fuels
Public transport reduces traffic congestion and carbon emissions

title: Part 2 - Situation 2: Planning a Family Vacation
content:
Situation: You are planning an upcoming vacation for your family and want to decide the best way to organize the trip. There are three options:
- Planning the entire trip by yourself (tự lên kế hoạch chuyến đi)
- Hiring a travel specialist or travel agency (nhờ chuyên gia / công ty du lịch)
- Asking a friend who has taken a similar trip (hỏi kinh nghiệm người bạn từng đi)

Which option do you think is the best choice and why?

chosen.khen1Text: because it is easy to start right away online, and I can choose places and hotels that fit comfortably within my family's budget and daily routine without sacrificing quality.

khen2ARE.answer: Planning the trip by myself is advantageous to my family's mental health and helps us reach a healthy balance between work and family time.
khen2ARE.example: For instance, I can book a quiet homestay by the beach and keep the afternoons free for family meals and talking together.
khen2ARE.reason: Because I know what my family enjoys most, I can plan a relaxing schedule so everyone can put their feet up, recharge their batteries, and reduce stress without rushing.

chosen.khen3Text: the best way to help all of us forget about work pressure, refresh our minds, and take meaningful photos together, while everything stays under our control.
chosen.option: Planning the entire trip by yourself

rejected.option: Hiring a travel specialist or travel agency
rejected.reason: hiring a travel agency costs too much money in service fees, and fixed group tours often feel stiff and rushed, so my family cannot enjoy private time freely.

rejected.option: Asking a friend who has taken a similar trip
rejected.reason: relying only on a friend's past experience may not suit my family's budget or needs, because travel prices change quickly and what a friend likes may be tiring for other family members.

Topic: Benefits of playing team sports
Suggestions:

followUps.answer: There are some popular sports competitions in Vietnam, such as national football leagues, school badminton tournaments, and city marathons.
followUps.example: For example, whenever the Vietnamese national football team plays, families and friends gather together to watch and cheer.
followUps.q: What sports competitions are popular in your country?
followUps.reason: Football and running events bring people together, create excitement, and encourage healthy habits for people of all ages.

followUps.answer: There are some problems that can happen when people play sports, such as physical injuries and arguments over winning or losing.
followUps.example: For instance, playing a fast football match without proper shoes or warming up can easily lead to a hurt ankle.
followUps.q: What problems can happen when people participate in sports?
followUps.reason: Without warming up properly or controlling emotions, players can hurt their legs or argue angrily with other players.

followUps.answer: I think individuals should build good self-discipline and join local sports clubs with friends, while authorities should build more public sports centers.
followUps.example: For example, joining a neighborhood badminton club at 6 PM after work helps busy people stay active three times a week.
followUps.q: How can people stay motivated to exercise regularly?
followUps.reason: Exercising in a friendly group makes workouts fun instead of boring, and convenient public facilities make it easy for everyone to join.

mindmapPoints.expand: because it enables us to keep fit, strengthen our immune system, and get into good shape.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it is good for our overall physical health.

title: Part 3 - Topic 3: Benefits of Keeping Pets
content:
Topic: Keeping pets brings many benefits to people's lives
Suggestions:
- Reducing stress and loneliness
- Encouraging regular outdoor exercise
- Teaching responsibility and care
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. What challenges or responsibilities do pet owners face?
2. Should families with young children keep pets at home? Why or why not?
3. What rules should pet owners follow in public areas?

hint.coreTopic: the benefits of keeping pets in people's lives

followUps.answer: There are some common challenges pet owners face, such as high costs for food and vet care, lack of time, and keeping public areas clean.
followUps.example: For example, if an owner works late every day or travels on holidays, their dog may feel lonely at home or make noise that disturbs neighbors.
followUps.q: What challenges or responsibilities do pet owners face?
followUps.reason: Busy workers may struggle to reach a healthy balance between work and caring for an animal, and keeping a pet requires daily cleaning and care.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think families with young children should keep friendly pets at home.
followUps.example: For instance, a 7-year-old child who helps feed a family cat or walk a small dog every afternoon learns to be more caring and active.
followUps.q: Should families with young children keep pets at home? Why or why not?
followUps.reason: Living with a pet teaches children practical life skills like feeding and caring for others, brings warm companionship every day, and reduces screen time.

followUps.answer: I think pet owners should follow clear rules in public places, and governments should enforce fines for violations.
followUps.example: For example, dog owners should always keep their dogs on a leash and carry waste bags when walking in public parks or on busy streets.
followUps.q: What rules should pet owners follow in public areas?
followUps.reason: Owners must build good self-discipline to clean up after their animals in public areas, while stricter rules help protect everyone's safety and keep parks clean.

mindmapPoints.expand: because it is advantageous to our mental health and brings warm companionship every day. It helps us unwind and relax, recharge our batteries, and elevate our mood after a day of hard work.
mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it has a positive effect on our mental health and overall well-being.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Keeping pets helps people reduce stress and loneliness.

mindmapPoints.expand: For example, dog owners often walk or run with their dogs in the local park every morning and evening, which allows them to keep fit, stay healthy, and strengthen their immune system.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to people's physical health.

mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on personal growth and family life.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Keeping pets teaches people responsibility and care.

questions.answer: Yes, I use AI tools on a regular basis in both my study and daily life.

title: Part 3 - Topic 4: Important Factors When Choosing a Job
content:
Topic: Key factors to consider when choosing a job
Suggestions:
- Attractive salary
- Positive work environment
- Friendly and supportive colleagues
- [Your own ideas]

Follow-up questions:
1. What are the disadvantages or difficulties young people face when choosing a job?
2. Which is more important to you: a high salary or job satisfaction?
3. Do you think people today change jobs more frequently than in the past?

hint.coreTopic: key factors to consider when choosing a job

followUps.answer: There are some major difficulties young people face when choosing a job, such as a lack of practical experience, low starting pay, and high competition.
followUps.example: For example, an IT graduate may spend three to four months sending out CVs because companies ask for at least one year of real work experience.
followUps.q: What are the disadvantages or difficulties young people face when choosing a job?
followUps.reason: Many fresh graduates struggle to find jobs because university lessons focus too much on theory instead of real company internships, and some jobs offer unstable income.

followUps.answer: I think job satisfaction is more important to me in the long run, as long as the salary covers my basic needs.
followUps.example: For instance, I would choose a teaching or office job that gives me time for my family and personal growth rather than a high-paid sales job with 12-hour shifts.
followUps.q: Which is more important to you: a high salary or job satisfaction?
followUps.reason: Doing work you enjoy is advantageous to your mental health and helps you relieve stress, while a stressful high-paying job can easily lead to burnout and fatigue.

followUps.answer: Yes, I think people today change jobs much more frequently than in the past.
followUps.example: For example, many young office workers in big cities switch companies after one or two years to look for higher pay or remote work options.
followUps.q: Do you think people today change jobs more frequently than in the past?
followUps.reason: Young people want better salaries, flexibility, and faster career growth, though changing jobs every few months makes employers doubt your loyalty and stops you from mastering deep professional skills.

mindmapPoints.expand: because a good income helps workers improve their living standard, pay for daily needs, and fit comfortably within their budget without sacrificing quality of life.

title: Topic 5: Shopping Habits
content:
1. How often do you go shopping, and who do you usually shop with?
2. Do you prefer shopping online or going to traditional stores? Why?
3. What kinds of items do you spend the most money on?

questions.answer: I usually go shopping once or twice a week, mostly with my mom or my close friends.
questions.example: Every Sunday afternoon, my mom and I go to the local market near our house to buy fresh food and household items.
questions.q: 1. How often do you go shopping, and who do you usually shop with?
questions.reason: Going shopping together is a fun way to spend quality time, strengthen our bonds, and elevate my mood after a busy week of studying.

questions.answer: Actually, I prefer going to traditional stores rather than shopping online, even though e-commerce apps are fast and convenient.
questions.example: Last month, I bought a jacket at a local shop near my school after trying it on to make sure the size and fabric were comfortable.
questions.q: 2. Do you prefer shopping online or going to traditional stores? Why?
questions.reason: Shopping on e-commerce apps often tempts buyers to waste money on cheap items that look nothing like the advertised photos, whereas going to stores lets me check the quality directly and stay on the safe side.

questions.answer: I spend the most money on fresh local food, comfortable clothes, and books for my study.
questions.example: Every month, I spend most of my allowance on fresh fruit, vegetables, and a couple of useful English textbooks at the bookstore.
questions.q: 3. What kinds of items do you spend the most money on?
questions.reason: Healthy food and good study materials play an essential role in keeping fit and broadening my mind, and I always choose items that fit comfortably within my budget.

hint.coreTopic: the importance of teamwork in study and work

followUps.answer: There are some common problems in teamwork, such as unequal effort, disagreements, and poor communication.
followUps.example: For example, in a university group project, two active students often end up writing the whole report because another member misses meetings and deadlines.
followUps.q: What problems can happen when people work in a team?
followUps.reason: Some members may be lazy and let others do all the work, or conflicts happen when people refuse to listen to each other with patience.

followUps.answer: I think I prefer working in a team for big projects because of the shared support.
followUps.example: For instance, when preparing an event or a class presentation, brainstorming with four classmates produces much better results than working by myself.
followUps.q: Do you prefer working in a team or working independently? Why?
followUps.reason: Working with like-minded people enriches my social life and helps solve hard problems faster, whereas working alone in a quiet environment is only better when I need deep focus.

followUps.answer: I think schools should organize more group projects, clubs, and team sports while guiding students on how to share duties equally.
followUps.example: For example, high schools can assign group science projects every term and ask each student to present their own part so nobody can rely on others.
followUps.q: How can schools help students develop better teamwork skills?
followUps.reason: Teachers should guide and support students to listen to each other with patience, while group activities let them practice communication in real situations.

mindmapPoints.impact: Therefore, it has a positive effect on work productivity and mental health.

mindmapPoints.expand: For example, when students prepare a group presentation, each person brings different views and knowledge, which enhances problem-solving skills and encourages creativity.
mindmapPoints.impact: Clearly, it is beneficial to learning results and new ideas.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Working in a team helps members generate diverse creative ideas.

mindmapPoints.expand: This is because working together lets us learn to listen, share opinions politely, and build a strong sense of belonging through face-to-face interaction.
mindmapPoints.impact: So, it has positive effects on our social network and career growth.
mindmapPoints.sentence: Teamwork helps people improve their communication and social skills.
